Paul — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Security (Mina) and Legal (Naomi) to scope a deliverable. Quick responses to the asks: 

- EU-only processing: yes, we can enforce EU-only model hosting and data residency for customer workloads. We typically do this via regional model pins and routing policies + optional private connector (VPC Peering / PrivateLink) for customer traffic. Need to align on whether Helios requires contractual language (DPA addendum + SCCs) or only operational controls.

- VPC/private connector + HSM: we can offer Private (VPC) deployments with customer-dedicated private connect and integrate with KMS/HSM for key separation. We will clarify HSM/TLS termination responsibilities.

- SIG/CAIQ/SOC2: Mina, can you confirm current package contents and estimated turnaround for a Helios-specific packet? Naomi, please advise on DPA/SCCs language we should propose.

I propose a 30-minute call later this week with Helios procurement to walk the packet and confirm contractual asks. Paul — what times work for you?

— Vivek

Hi all,

Thanks Vivek / Paul. Quick inventory and recommended next steps from Security: 

What we can provide immediately ("initial evidence pack", target 7-10 business days):
- Redwood SOC 2 report (latest) — see attached stub (redwood_soc2-cert.pdf).
- SIG summary mapping — a condensed spreadsheet that maps Helios control IDs to Redwood controls (redwood_SIG-summary.zip).
- CAIQ (full) export — we can provide the CAIQ template export (redwood_caiq.xlsx) and a short guidance memo on items that require operational context.
- Network diagram and VPC/private-connector runbook excerpt (we will include a technical appendix).

DPIA / data residency notes:
- Operationally we provide EU-only model hosting by pinning workloads to EU regions and disabling cross-region logging by default. Token-level telemetry can be scoped out or routed to a customer-managed telemetry sink in their VPC — we will document options in the appendix.
- For full DPIA we need Helios to complete the attached intake form (they already sent it) and supply dataflows for the pilot. From our side, the DPIA review cycle is typically 3-6 weeks depending on completeness; we can prioritize the initial risk summary faster.

Contractual items:
- We will need a DPA addendum including SCCs (we can propose the standard Clause 2024 text). Naomi — please advise on specific language for Helios procurement team.

Attachments pending: redwood_SIG-summary.zip, redwood_caiq.xlsx, redwood_soc2-cert.pdf.
